prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene depicts a quiet hospital corridor. On the left stands a nurse in blue scrubs, holding a clipboard tightly against her chest. Next to her, a young boy in a striped shirt sits on a metal bench, his legs swinging slightly above the floor. In the center of the hallway, an elderly woman in a floral dress points toward a distant door, her finger extended with urgency. Beside her, a golden retriever sits calmly, looking up at the woman with attentive eyes. To the right, a doctor in a white coat hands a small paper cup to a patient in a gray gown, who reaches out with a trembling hand to accept it. Leaning against the wall near the doctor is a tall IV stand with empty bags hanging from its hooks. The nurse looks at the boy on the bench, offering a subtle nod of reassurance. The boy looks back at the nurse, his expression softening. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. The lines are loose and expressive, capturing the transient nature of the moment without heavy shading. The color wash is pale, adding just enough warmth to the sterile environment to make it feel human. The perspective draws the eye down the long corridor, where the figures are arranged to create a sense of depth and narrative flow. Each character is distinct in their attire and posture, contributing to the overall story of care and waiting. The simplicity of the medium allows the viewer to focus on the interactions and the quiet dignity of the subjects.
